item.title: The silent winners of 2025: Paxos & Steakhouse Financial
item.author: Token Terminal
item.content:encoded:
**Each week in The Snapshot, we share data-driven insights, highlight new listings, and showcase our latest product updates.**
Read on for the latest edition 👇
### **Vault curators emerge as a new DeFi business category**
![Chart](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a818421b-60ad-4f22-a80e-16630a1ccc35/download__2_.png?t=1768501720)
[View dashboard](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/studio/dashboards/928b2a19-a4e6-4c13-a1c5-ab682c49abf3?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=the-silent-winners-of-2025-paxos-steakhouse-financial)
- **Vault curators have emerged as a distinct layer in DeFi, with Steakhouse Financial alone managing ~$1.8b in deposits on Morpho.** Curators allocate capital across multiple lending markets, handling strategy design, and ongoing risk monitoring on behalf of depositors. - **Vault curators emerged because Morpho's modular design enables strategies that traditional lending protocols cannot easily support.** Protocols like Aave set supply caps and market parameters through governance. Morpho allows curators to build tailored multi-market strategies and, through active management, potentially capture demand that governance-constrained protocols leave unmet. - **Vault curation is becoming a meaningful DeFi business category.** Steakhouse's ~$1.8b in deposits exceeds the ecosystem TVL of major chains like Aptos (~$1.7b). At a 10% performance fee on an assumed 5% average yield, that deposit base would imply roughly $9m in annual revenue for the curator, which reportedly employs less than 20 people.
### **Paxos: the infrastructure behind PYUSD and USDG**
![Chart](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1f1b44ec-6a61-400d-9609-3109fee0e0f0/download__3_.png?t=1768501739)
[View dashboard](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/metrics/outstanding-supply?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=the-silent-winners-of-2025-paxos-steakhouse-financial)
- **The total market cap of assets issued by Paxos has grown from ~$1b to ~$6.7b since January 2025.** Paxos is the regulated issuer behind PayPal's PYUSD, the Global Dollar Network's USDG, and the tokenized gold product PAXG. While partners like PayPal handle distribution, Paxos provides issuance infrastructure and regulatory compliance. - **Paxos has positioned itself as the trusted backend for partners who want stablecoin products without building blockchain infrastructure.** PayPal and the Global Dollar Network consortium (Kraken, Robinhood, Galaxy Digital, etc.) chose Paxos because of its regulatory credentials, including an OCC national trust charter in the U.S., MAS license in Singapore, and MiCA compliance in Europe. - **However, Paxos' infrastructure-first model means limited economics at the issuer level.** Both USDG and PYUSD pass on a majority of the reserve yield to their users. As a result, Paxos earns a smaller percentage of the reserve yield, but is better positioned to scale through enterprise partnerships, where the customers have more control over the economics.
### **Solana's stablecoin landscape is diversifying**
![Chart](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/283327b6-bdcc-4c06-a0e5-a2de62b04cb7/download__4_.png?t=1768501749)
[View dashboard](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/studio/dashboards/928b2a19-a4e6-4c13-a1c5-ab682c49abf3?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=the-silent-winners-of-2025-paxos-steakhouse-financial)
- **Non-USDC/USDT stablecoins now account for ~20% of Solana's total stablecoin supply, up from ~3% a year ago.** Beyond USDC, Solana now hosts PYUSD, USDG, USD1, EURC, FDUSD, and over a dozen other deployments, including non-dollar stablecoins like the Swiss franc (VCHF) and Euro (EURC). - **Solana-native applications are also launching their own stablecoins.** Phantom (the leading Solana wallet) launched CASH; Jupiter launched jupUSD. This signals that Solana's app ecosystem is mature enough for native teams to expand their offerings to multiple financial products. - **For Solana, this diversification reduces concentration risk and signals issuer confidence.** A year ago, a regulatory issue affecting Circle (USDC issuer) would have threatened Solana's entire stablecoin base. Today, a diversified issuer set makes the network more resilient, and the fact that new issuers are choosing Solana is a vote of confidence in the ecosystem.
### **Ethereum L1 hits record transactions at record-low fees**
![Chart](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6a777b41-8c7b-4b56-b8a7-9a2c6117c04c/download__5_.png?t=1768501757)
[View dashboard](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/studio/dashboards/928b2a19-a4e6-4c13-a1c5-ab682c49abf3?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=the-silent-winners-of-2025-paxos-steakhouse-financial)
- **Ethereum L1 transaction counts have reached all-time highs, while median transaction fees remain near all-time lows.** Weekly transactions recently surpassed 12m, with median transaction fees below $0.02 - a stark contrast to 2021-2022 when fees regularly exceeded $20. - **Ethereum's recent scaling upgrades have materially reduced L1 fee pressure, restoring mainnet usability at scale.** The introduction of blobspace via EIP-4844, alongside continued rollup adoption, has shifted the most price-sensitive activity off L1. This has reduced congestion on mainnet, allowing transaction volumes to reach new highs without the fee spikes that historically constrained L1 usage. - **More predictable and consistently low L1 fees are making Ethereum mainnet attractive again for application builders.** As the cost differential between L1 and L2 execution narrows, teams that benefit from Ethereum's native liquidity, composability, and security are reassessing mainnet deployment. This dynamic is beginning to show up in builder behavior, including L2-native applications exploring or announcing expansions to Ethereum L1 as the economic trade-offs change.
Access the charts [here](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/studio/dashboards/66a1fc7f-dab5-4193-9b2e-004099c7682c?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=the-silent-winners-of-2025-paxos-steakhouse-financial).

item.author: Token Terminal
item.content:encoded:
Each week in The Snapshot, we share data-driven insights, highlight new listings, and showcase our latest product updates.
Read on for the latest edition 👇
![Snapshot_title_-_Charts_of_the_week.png](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/08603125-4c42-424e-8643-95fa22e4c6f9/Snapshot_title_-_Charts_of_the_week.png?t=1763664261)
## What is Circle?
Circle is a publicly listed fintech company best known as the issuer of USDC, the world's second-largest stablecoin with a market cap of $77.3 billion.
Circle's business has historically been defined by USDC, raising the question of whether the company has meaningful growth vectors beyond its flagship product.
The following charts show that Circle is expanding into *transaction-based revenues (CCTP), yield-bearing assets (USYC), and new geographic markets (EURC).*.
## 1) With the CCTP bridge, Circle is making a push into transaction-based revenues
![circle_1.png](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/7f8fbc08-55c5-425d-9b34-5691c0d848c1/circle_1.png?t=1765463218)
[CCTP transfer volume: the total value of tokens transferred through Circle's CCTP.](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/circle/metrics/transfer-volume?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here)
1. **Native USDC bridge.** CCTP is Circle's cross-chain transfer protocol that burns USDC on the source chain and mints native USDC on the destination chain, unifying USDC liquidity across 15+ blockchains. 2. **Fixes bridge fragmentation.** CCTP removes wrapped-USDC bridges and external liquidity pools, reducing bridge risk, capital lockups, and operational complexity for exchanges, wallets, and applications that move USDC between chains. 3. **Fee-based volume growth.** CCTP V2 charges onchain Fast Transfer fees at mint and is already processing $28.9 billion in quarterly transfer volume, up 6.3x YoY, turning cross-chain USDC movement into a growing transaction-revenue line for Circle.
## 2) With the USYC TMMF, Circle is making a push into yield-bearing assets
![circle_2.png](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/54e4cd9f-130d-4721-8104-aa2a231a8fe2/circle_2.png?t=1765463500)
[Market cap: the total value that has been tokenized onchain for USYC.](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/circle/usyc/metrics/asset-market-cap-circulating?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here)
1. **Tokenized MMF shares.** USYC is the onchain representation of the Hashnote International Short Duration Yield Fund, a tokenized money market fund that invests in short-term U.S. government-backed securities and reverse repos. 2. **Onchain yield access.** USYC gives eligible non-U.S. institutions 24/7, USDC-settled access to institutional Treasury yields with programmable, near-instant subscriptions and redemptions, solving for slow and operationally heavy traditional fund rails. 3. **Recurring fee engine.** USYC charges a 10% performance fee on yield plus subscription and redemption fees, and has scaled to more than $1 billion in assets, creating a growing stream of fee-based revenue for Circle as tokenized money market funds gain share.
## 3) With the EURC stablecoin, Circle is making a push into the EU market
![circle_3.png](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/dcfdde71-9e0d-42ab-adf8-6ee411019eb1/circle_3.png?t=1765463717)
[Market cap: the total value that has been tokenized onchain for EURC.](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/circle/eurc/metrics/asset-market-cap-circulating?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here)
1. **Euro stablecoin.** EURC is Circle's fully reserved, MiCA-compliant euro stablecoin, issued on Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Solana, and Stellar and redeemable 1:1 for euro. 2. **Solves euro liquidity gap.** EURC provides regulated euro liquidity for payments, FX, and DeFi in Europe, giving businesses a compliant alternative to unregulated euro tokens and extending Circle's stablecoin model beyond USD. 3. **Interest and fee upside.** EURC adds euro reserves and fiat–stablecoin conversion flows to Circle's interest and transaction-fee revenue base, and its market cap has grown 150% YTD to $367.4 million, making it the largest euro stablecoin and a fast-growing contributor to Circle's stablecoin economics.
Access the charts [here](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/studio/dashboards/0af92a69-f2c1-410b-97f1-49f374af6748?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here).
![Snapshot_title_-_New_on_TT.png](https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/2e70f138-1594-45d4-a99d-07963ab7c2ab/Snapshot_title_-_New_on_TT.png?t=1763661587)
### Project updates:
* Listed [Starknet](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/starknet?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here), an L2 smart contract platform for scaling Ethereum using STARK proofs for secure, decentralized computation. * Listed [Deliswap](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/bmx/deliswap?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here), a DEX on Base, as a product of [BMX](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/bmx?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here). * Listed [Stargate](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/layerzero/stargate?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here), a composable cross-chain liquidity bridge, as a product of [LayerZero](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/projects/layerzero?utm_source=tokenterminal.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=circle-s-second-act-is-already-here).

### Asset updates:

### Metric updates:
